sentences.text:
2] This is the applicant's third bail application filed under Section 483 of B.N.S.S./ 439 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973, as he/ she is implicated in connection with Crime No.538/2022 registered at Police Station Raipuriya, District Jhabua (MP) for offence punishable under Sections 363, 366A,
376(3), 376(2)(n) and 376(d)(A) of IPC , and Section 5(L)/6 and 5(g)/6 of POCSO Act.
The applicant is in custody since 25.12.2022.
His earlier two applications have already been dismissed as withdrawn.
3] The allegation against the applicant is of rape.
4] Counsel for the applicant has submitted that the prosecutrix has already been examined in the Trial Court on 03.08.2023, and she has not supported the case of the prosecution.
It is further submitted that the applicant is lodged in jail since 25.12.2022 and the final conclusion of trial is likely to take sufficient long time.
Thus, the application may be allowed.

NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:29131 2 MCRC-41360-2025 5] Counsel for the State,
on the other hand, has opposed the prayer and it is submitted that the FSL report is positive,

sentences.text: although, it is admitted that there is no DNA report available on record.

6] Having considered the rival submissions, and on perusal of the case-diary, it is found that the prosecutrix has not supported the case of the prosecution, although, even according to the prosecution she has resided with the applicant for around two months.

In such circumstances,
looking to the period of incarceration, as the applicant is lodged in jail since last around two years and ten months, this Court is inclined to allow the present application.
7] Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application filed by the applicant is allowed.

The applicant is directed to be released on bail upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his/her regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he / she shall remain present before the court concerned during trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.

8] M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of .
